name: cost-band
description: Status line with session $ and cache ratio ("$12.34 · cache 87%"), always on; above the prompt an amber band from the nudge cost (default $15) saying to start a new session, red at the limit (default $20), and one toast at each. Refreshes after each turn and every 60 s.

limit_usd.title: Session cost limit (USD)
limit_usd.description: The band turns red at this cost. If the nudge is not below it, amber starts at 80% of this.

nudge_usd.title: Start-a-new-session nudge (USD)
nudge_usd.description: From this cost the band turns amber and says to start a new session; a toast fires once here and once at the limit.
